title: Collapse SemanticBoneResolver raw/snapshot duplication to one authoritative path
description:
## Summary

Collapse the duplicated raw-definition and resolved-snapshot implementations of the same parent/Body-socket resolution decisions in `SemanticBoneResolver` into one authoritative snapshot path. An external audit (P2) found parallel authority that the resolved-snapshot architecture is meant to eliminate: bug fixes can land in one path and not the other.

Provenance: `docs/audits/creaturecreator-deep-dive-code-review-2026-09-05.md` P2 (SemanticBoneResolver). Verified at current HEAD `99fe6ad`: raw `CreatureDefinition` overloads (`ResolveParentBoneId`, `ResolveBodyParentBoneId`) coexist with snapshot overloads. Broad owner family: TSK-0095 (snapshot authority / generation stage boundaries). No existing TSK owns this collapse.

## Scope

`Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Skeleton/SemanticBoneResolver.cs`:

- Make the `ResolvedCreatureSnapshot` overloads the canonical implementation of parent-bone and Body-socket decisions.
- Turn the raw-`CreatureDefinition` overloads into thin compatibility entry points that resolve/canonicalize once and delegate to the snapshot path, or remove them after caller migration.
- Preserve identical outputs between the raw and snapshot paths during the transition; add a parity test.
- Do not introduce a new resolver abstraction or service.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The snapshot overload is the single implementation of parent/Body-socket resolution; the raw overload (if retained) delegates and produces identical results.
- A parity test proves raw overload and snapshot overload produce identical outputs for representative definitions (including mirrored and Body-attached parts).
- Mutation of the source `CreatureDefinition` after snapshot creation never changes the resolved path.
- Existing semantic-resolution tests remain green.

## Validation

Focused runtime tests for raw-vs-snapshot parity and snapshot immutability. Run the full Unity runtime suites. Static source inspection alone cannot close this task.

## Findings

- Duplicated policy: Body-rooted vs non-Body parent classification, Body-surface-anchor socket selection, nearest-Body-sample fallback, mirrored-parent handling, and limb-terminal attachment selection are each implemented for raw and resolved inputs.
- The snapshot overload exists specifically to avoid observing mutable authoring state after resolution; keeping a second raw algorithm re-opens that risk.

## Blockers

None known.

## Next Step

Designate the snapshot path canonical, make the raw overload delegate (or migrate callers), and add the parity test.

comments.body:
## Implementation evidence (sprint round 1)

Collapsed SemanticBoneResolver raw/snapshot duplication to ONE authoritative decision core:
- Extracted `ResolveParentBoneIdCore(...)` and `ResolveBodyParentBoneIdCore(...)` as the single implementations of the parent-bone and Body-socket decisions.
- Both the raw-`CreatureDefinition` overloads (`ResolveParentBoneId`/`ResolveBodyParentBoneId`) and the snapshot overloads now read inputs from their own source and funnel through the SAME core, so the two paths cannot drift.
- Snapshot overloads remain canonical for normal generation (immutability preserved). Raw overloads retained ONLY as thin compatibility adapters because `SkeletonInferrer`'s malformed-DNA defensive fallback resolves parts from authored DNA that cannot be canonicalized into a snapshot (snapshot `Resolve` throws on missing parent/null Parts). A raw->snapshot delegate would regress those fallback tests.
- No new resolver abstraction/service; no new snapshot type.

Files changed:
- `Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Skeleton/SemanticBoneResolver.cs`
- `Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime/SemanticBoneResolverTests.cs`

## Validation evidence
- `git diff --check`: pass (exit 0).
- `dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore`: pass.
- `dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore`: pass.
- Unity PlayMode (report-backed, editor reachable): SemanticBoneResolverTests 12/12; SkeletonInferrerTests 12/12 (regression guard). No console errors.
- New tests: `RawAndSnapshotParentResolvers_ProduceIdenticalIds_ForRepresentativeParts` (Body-attached, mirrored non-limb, limb-with-child, mirrored-limb-child, anchored Body child; both mirror flags); `SnapshotResolver_BodySocket_DoesNotChangeAfterAuthoredBodyMutation` (moves authored Body sample after snapshot construction, asserts captured socket kept).

## Residual risk
Raw overloads remain as shared-core adapters (not deleted) solely for the SkeletonInferrer malformed fallback. Fully removing them would require a separate rework of that fallback; tracked as optional future work, not required for this task's acceptance.
